name: r1-simulator
description: Concurrent R1, Unitree G1 and AUBO C5 physical manipulation in one selectable workcell

scripts.test: npm run test:performance-contracts && npm run test:multi && npm run test:pipes && npm run test:models && npm run test:framing && npm run test:visuals
scripts.test:performance-contracts: node work/test-camera-feed-async-perf-v2.mjs && node work/test-camera-feed-queue-perf-v2.mjs && node work/test-planning-check-cache.mjs
scripts.test:multi: node work/test-multi-coordinator.mjs --report=work/validation/performance-v2/coordinator-final.json && node work/test-multi-ui.mjs --report=work/validation/performance-v2/ui-static-final.json && npm run test:responsiveness && npm run test:planning && npm run test:background-planning && node work/test-multi-r1-gripper.mjs --report=work/validation/performance-v2/r1-gripper-final.json && node work/test-multi-physical.mjs --background-planning --report=work/validation/performance-v2/sort-physical-compiled-model-final.json && node work/test-multi-stack.mjs --background-planning --report=work/validation/performance-v2/stack-physical-compiled-model-final.json
scripts.test:pipes: node work/test-pipe-scatter.mjs --report=work/validation/performance-v2/pipe-scatter-final.json && node work/test-pipe-ui.mjs --report=work/validation/performance-v2/pipe-ui-final.json && node work/test-multi-pipes.mjs --background-planning --report=work/validation/performance-v2/pipes-physical-compiled-model-final.json
scripts.test:models: node work/test-r1-dynamics.mjs && node work/test-r1-initial-pose.mjs && node work/test-r1-camera.mjs && node work/test-r1-waist-assist.mjs && node work/test-r1-natural-grasp.mjs && node work/test-g1-dynamics.mjs && node work/test-c5-dynamics.mjs && node work/test-c5-visuals.mjs
scripts.test:c5: node work/test-c5-dynamics.mjs && node work/test-c5-visuals.mjs && node work/test-c5-opening-safety.mjs && node work/test-c5-manual-motion.mjs && node work/test-c5-dynamic-grasp.mjs
scripts.test:g1: node work/test-g1-dynamics.mjs && node work/test-g1-opening-safety.mjs && node work/test-g1-dynamic-grasp.mjs
scripts.test:repeat: npm run test:multi && npm run test:multi && npm run test:multi
scripts.test:acceptance: node work/test-multi-acceptance-verifier.mjs --report-dir=work/validation/performance-v2 --physical-suffix=-compiled-model --require-background --output=work/validation/performance-v2/multi-verifier-final.json && node work/verify-multi-acceptance.mjs --report-dir=work/validation/performance-v2 --physical-suffix=-compiled-model --require-background --output=work/validation/performance-v2/multi-acceptance-final.json && node work/test-pipe-acceptance-verifier.mjs --require-background --report=work/validation/performance-v2/pipes-physical-compiled-model-final.json --output=work/validation/performance-v2/pipe-verifier-final.json && node work/verify-pipe-acceptance.mjs --require-background --report=work/validation/performance-v2/pipes-physical-compiled-model-final.json --output=work/validation/performance-v2/pipes-acceptance-final.json
scripts.build:physics: node work/build-r1-dynamics.mjs && node work/build-g1-dynamics.mjs && node work/build-c5-dynamics.mjs
